_comment: skill id -> [check id, ...]. This is the ONLY file coupled to the current skill taxonomy -- if Expo renames/merges/splits skills later, only this mapping changes, not the checks themselves (see registry.py's module docstring). Only expo-router and expo-project-structure are mapped so far (phase 1); skills without an entry here simply get a 'no uptake checks mapped' warning, same as an unmapped skill did under the old skill_cases/ format.
